packages.title: ONS — Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type and industry — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK fossil-fuel use by fuel type and SIC industry, 1990 to 2024.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-05.
The dataset includes coal, natural gas, petrol, DERV, fuel oil, gas oil and aviation fuel among its fuel categories.
The table excludes biofuels and waste.
Handling boundary: fuel-use activity is not itself an observed greenhouse-gas quantity.

packages.title: DfT — UK aviation forecast 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is Long-term UK airport passenger, aircraft-movement and CO2 forecasts.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-18.
DfT publishes 2026 forecasts for passengers, aircraft movements and CO2 emissions for UK airports.
The publication is a strategic forecast supported by modelling and data tables.
Handling boundary: forecast CO2 values must remain modelled forecasts rather than observed current emissions.

packages.title: DfT — Vehicle licensing statistics: January to March 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK and Great Britain vehicle licensing and first-registration statistics for Q1 2026.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-07-15.
The release reports 769,000 vehicles first registered in the UK in Q1 2026, including 150,000 zero-emission vehicles.
At the end of March 2026 it reports 42.4 million licensed vehicles in the UK, including 2.148 million zero-emission vehicles.
Handling boundary: vehicle stock and registration flows are activity indicators, not parcel GHG measurements.

packages.title: Environment Agency — UK ETS maritime: how to comply — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK ETS maritime monitoring, reporting and surrender compliance.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-22.
The first maritime UK ETS scheme year runs from 1 July to 31 December 2026.
Maritime monitoring covers CO2, N2O and CH4 within scheme scope and uses verified annual emissions reporting.
Handling boundary: allowance surrender and compliance accounting must remain distinct from parcel emissions.

packages.title: Environment Agency — Pollution Inventory — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is England regulated-site annual releases and waste transfers, with files through reporting year 2024.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-04-17.
The Pollution Inventory collates annual mass releases to air, controlled waters and sewers plus waste transferred off site.
Reporting can include point sources and non-point or fugitive emissions across the regulated authorisation or permit.
Handling boundary: permit-wide facility releases must not be assigned to individual parcels without explicit geometry and attribution evidence.
